user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Used to surface websites in search results in ChatGPT's search features.
user_agents.scope: ChatGPT search features and navigational search answers.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validates the safety and compliance of web pages submitted as ads.
user_agents.scope: Visits only landing pages submitted as ads on ChatGPT.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web content for training generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content to make foundation models more useful and safe.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Performs user-initiated browsing actions in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: Visits pages when users ask questions or interact via GPT Actions.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules may not apply as actions are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content that could contribute to training generative AI models.
user_agents.scope: Gathers public web data to enhance utility and safety of AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt to exclude materials from AI model training datasets.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses websites to answer user questions directed to Claude AI.
user_agents.scope: Retrieves web content in response to user-initiated queries.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt to prevent content retrieval for user queries.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Navigates web to improve search result quality and accuracy for users.
user_agents.scope: Analyzes and indexes online content for search optimization.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt to prevent indexing content for search results.

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Find information for building Google's search indexes and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Google Search, Discover, Google Images, Google Video, and Google News.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt for Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Fetch image files for Google Images and Search features.
user_agents.scope: Google Images, Discover, Google Video, and Google Search image features.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt for Googlebot-Image or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video
user_agents.purpose: Fetch video content for Google Search and dependent products.
user_agents.scope: Video-related Google Search features and products dependent on videos.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt for Googlebot-Video or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content for Google News.
user_agents.scope: Google News product, including news.google.com and the Google News app.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt for Googlebot-News or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google
user_agents.purpose: Crawl surfaces for Google Shopping.
user_agents.scope: All surfaces of Google Shopping.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt for Storebot-Google.

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Power Search testing tools and URL inspection.
user_agents.scope: Rich Result Test and Search Console URL inspection.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt for Google-InspectionTool or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Fetch publicly accessible content for internal research and development.
user_agents.scope: Generic crawls across various Google product teams.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt for GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Fetch publicly accessible image URLs for research and development.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible image URLs across Google products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt for GoogleOther-Image or GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Fetch publicly accessible video URLs for research and development.
user_agents.scope: Publicly accessible video URLs across Google products.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt for GoogleOther-Video or GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Execute owner-requested crawls for building Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.scope: Crawl requests for Vertex AI Agents.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt for Google-CloudVertexBot or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Google-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Manage content use for Gemini training and grounding.
user_agents.scope: Training Gemini models and grounding in Gemini Apps and Vertex AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt for Google-Extended.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index information from the internet to deliver search experience.
user_agents.scope: Collects data operating automatically or in response to user requests.
user_agents.opt_out: Manage access using robots.txt tags.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gather and index information operating in response to user requests.
user_agents.scope: User agent collecting web data based on user actions.
user_agents.opt_out: Manage access using robots.txt tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search technology and trains foundation models across Apple products.
user_agents.scope: General search web crawling and rendering across the web.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt or use robots meta tags like noindex.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Controls use of website content for training Apple's generative foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Does not crawl; determines usage of data crawled by Applebot.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Only crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content of apps or websites shared on Meta apps.
user_agents.scope: Gathers, caches, and displays preview information like title, description, and thumbnail image.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt; might bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Improve Meta AI search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Analyzes online content to enhance relevance and accuracy, enabling citations in Meta AI responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule for meta-webindexer in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Improve advertising and other business-related products and services.
user_agents.scope: Crawls the web to enhance advertising and business products.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule for meta-externalads in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Train foundation AI models or improve products by indexing content.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content directly for training AI models and product improvement.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule for meta-externalagent in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetch links at user request and evaluate agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: Fetches individual links and helps AI navigate websites to complete user tasks.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt rules because fetches are requested by users.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improves Amazon products and services and trains AI models.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content to improve Amazon services and train AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow via robots.txt or use noarchive/noindex meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improves search experiences in Amazon products and services such as Alexa.
user_agents.scope: Crawls content to appear in Amazon search experiences without AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Amzn-SearchBot in robots.txt or use noindex meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Supports user actions by fetching live information to answer user queries.
user_agents.scope: Fetches live web information on behalf of users for accurate answers.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives because actions are user-initiated.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web pages to build an open dataset for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: A randomly selected sample and subset of pages across the web.
user_agents.opt_out: Set Disallow: / for CCBot in robots.txt or join the opt-out registry.
